title: Fermat's Last Theorem in Lean 4
summary: A Lean 4 formalization of Fermat's Last Theorem, providing a computer-verified proof of one of mathematics' most famous unsolved problems that remained unproven for over 350 years until Andrew Wiles' 1995 proof.
problem_solved: Provides a machine-checked, formally verified proof of Fermat's Last Theorem, eliminating any possibility of human error in the original mathematical proof.
why_valuable: Formal verification ensures absolute mathematical certainty and makes the proof verifiable by computers, advancing the field of formalized mathematics and proof assistants.
